register_scope: Mainline GitHub Actions workflows only. Prototype workflows and their evidence are documented and tested on their own branch; they are not certified by this register.
update_rule: Any workflow addition, removal, rename, trigger change, job change, runner change, runtime change, or command change must update this register in the same pull request. CI verifies inventory and selected executable configuration fields.
evidence_rule: A workflow definition describes configured scope, not a successful run. Every reported pass must cite the exact workflow run URL, tested commit SHA, event, conclusion, job, command, and limitations.

workflows.name: ScoutSA mainline documentation integrity
verifies: README and canonical gate-status synchronization for explicitly tested status facts
Share-card non-authorization, derived readiness constraints, and outcome provenance/dispute semantics
CI workflow inventory and selected trigger/job/runtime/command configuration
Safeguarding measurement contract completeness and non-coercive metric rules
Third-party GitHub Actions are pinned to verified immutable release commits and their versions are checked by CI
does_not_prove: Every semantic contradiction across every repository document
Legal compliance, safeguarding effectiveness, consent validity, or operational readiness
Prototype branch correctness or runtime behavior
Production security, RLS, API, database, or UI behavior
Stakeholder validation, market demand, or real-world outcomes
